item.title: How to install Ghent University's printers on Ubuntu
item.description: Ghent University uses Ricoh Streamline NX for secure printing. The current official guide to add the printers to Ubuntu is quite outdated. It guides you to an old LPD protocol that doesn’t seem to work anymore, and it uses an old settings tool that is gone in modern versions of GNOME.
